subtitle: Cross-check of 02/Oct/2026: Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 02/Oct, 16:07 BRT, the national poll released on 02/Oct, Vox Brasil BR-00148/2026, the five from 30/Sep and 01/Oct, Datafolha BR-08039/2026, Real Time Big Data BR-09503/2026, Futura/100% Cidades BR-01122/2026, Ideia BR-08706/2026 and Indexa BR-00698/2026, and the press flow of 01 and 02/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 42.50% (vol USD 13.76M cumulative) in the winner contract, up 5.00pp raw and 4.34pp normalized, confirmed reading of 02/Oct, 16:07 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 4.55pp, to 23.70% (vol USD 1.28M). POLL: 40.4% to 41.2% in the first round and 45.2% to 48.2% in the second in Vox Brasil of 02/Oct; he leads the first round in four of the six national polls from 30/Sep to 02/Oct and the second in three.
fortes: Rises 5.00pp in the winner contract, to 42.50%, and the gap narrows from 23.55pp to 15.25pp, after five straight widenings between confirmed readings. Normalized by the pair's sum, which rose from 98.55 to 100.25, the gain is 4.34pp.

Leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the six national polls from 30/Sep to 02/Oct: 42% to 38% in Datafolha, 43% to 39% in Real Time Big Data, 39% to 34% in Indexa and 39.4% to 38.4% in Ideia.

Leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha, 48% to 45%, in Indexa, 43% to 42%, and in Ideia, 48.5% to 48%. In Vox Brasil of 02/Oct he beats Ronaldo Caiado by 46.3% to 42.1% and Augusto Cury by 46.8% to 33.1%.
fracos: In Vox Brasil of 02/Oct he trails in both rounds, 40.4% to 41.2% and 45.2% to 48.2%, after leading the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by 41.1% to 37.8% in the pollster's round of 29/Sep.
Trails in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in three of the six national polls from 30/Sep to 02/Oct: Real Time Big Data, Futura and Vox Brasil.
In the series recorded since April 14 his price is 25.00pp from the high, 67.50% on 16/Aug.
📺 He would not attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, which the broadcaster cancelled, attributing the cancellation to the court rulings that barred the empty podium and the questions to him.
candidates.analise: Lula rose 5.00pp in the winner contract, to 42.50% (vol USD 13.76M cumulative), in the confirmed reading of 02/Oct, 16:07 BRT, and 4.34pp normalized, because the pair's sum rose from 98.55 to 100.25; with that the gap narrows from 23.55pp to 15.25pp, after five straight widenings between confirmed readings. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 4.55pp, to 23.70%. 🗳️ In the six national polls from 30/Sep to 02/Oct he leads the first round in four and the second in three, and Vox Brasil, which is the chart's benchmark, puts him 0.8 point behind in the first round and 3 in the second. 📺 On the night of 01/Oct TV Globo cancelled the presidential debate and attributed the cancellation to the court rulings of the preceding hours, which in the broadcaster's view created legal uncertainty (Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital, G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 57.75% (vol USD 13.49M cumulative) in the winner contract, down 3.30pp raw and 4.34pp normalized, confirmed reading of 02/Oct, 16:07 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 5.00pp, to 76.50% (vol USD 1.51M). POLL: 41.2% in the first round and 48.2% in the second in Vox Brasil of 02/Oct; he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in three of the six national polls from 30/Sep to 02/Oct.
fortes: Leads both rounds in Vox Brasil of 02/Oct, 41.2% to 40.4% and 48.2% to 45.2%, after trailing in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by 37.8% to 41.1% in the pollster's round of 29/Sep.
Leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in three of the six national polls from 30/Sep to 02/Oct, with the largest distance in Futura, 49% to 43.5%, the only one outside the margin.
In the series recorded since April 14 his price is 5.55pp from the recorded top, 63.30% on 01/Oct.

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep the second-round vote transfer from the other names favours him: 81% of Romeu Zema's voters, 48% of Renan Santos's, 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's and 34% of Augusto Cury's would go to him (O Globo).
fracos: Falls 3.30pp in the winner contract, to 57.75%, and the gap narrows from 23.55pp to 15.25pp, after five straight widenings between confirmed readings.
In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 5.00pp, to 76.50%: the market pays more for the chance that he finishes the first round in second place.
Trails in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the six national polls from 30/Sep to 02/Oct, with the largest distance in Indexa, 34% to 39%.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📺 He announced he would not attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct after the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) injunction that barred the empty podium and the questions to Lula, citing censorship; the broadcaster cancelled the debate, attributing the cancellation to the court rulings.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.

cruzamento: The winner contract narrowed the gap after five straight widenings, and the day's only national poll put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in both rounds. 🗳️ On 02/Oct, Vox Brasil (BR-00148/2026, n=2,100, fieldwork from 29/Sep to 01/Oct) gives Flávio Bolsonaro 41.2% to 40.4% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 48.2% to 45.2% in the second, after Lula led the first round by 41.1% to 37.8% in the pollster's round of 29/Sep. In the six national polls released from 30/Sep to 02/Oct, Lula leads the first round in four (Datafolha, Real Time Big Data, Indexa and Ideia) and trails in two (Futura and Vox Brasil), and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) they split three for each side: Lula in Datafolha, Indexa and Ideia, and Flávio Bolsonaro in Real Time Big Data, Futura and Vox Brasil; only Futura falls outside the margin in the second round. 💹 In the confirmed reading of 02/Oct, 16:07 BRT, Lula rises 5.00pp, to 42.50%, and Flávio Bolsonaro falls 3.30pp, to 57.75%, with 4.34pp for each side normalized, and the gap narrows from 23.55pp to 15.25pp, after five straight widenings between confirmed readings. 🥉 In the third-place book of the first round Renan Santos pulls away, 62.50% to Augusto Cury's 27.30%. 📺 In the news, on the night of 01/Oct TV Globo cancelled the presidential debate and attributed the cancellation to the court rulings of the preceding hours, which in the broadcaster's view created legal uncertainty (Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital, G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). At around 18h30 Justice Estela Aranha, of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), issued an injunction barring the showing of Lula's empty podium and the questions directed at him, and Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes ordered the inclusion of Renan Santos, which Kassio Nunes Marques and Cármen Lúcia had denied (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo). Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro had already announced they would not attend. Gazeta do Povo called the TSE ruling that made the debate unviable unprecedented. 🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to polls or to acts: it measures both sides with each one's timestamps.
